resources.string: Tap here to open PikPak\'s website and import the session automatically.
Logged in. Tap here to replace the saved PikPak session.
Forget the saved session and sign out of the PikPak page. Your files are not touched.
Logged in. The session refreshes automatically (valid for %1$s).
Logged in. The access token is being refreshed.

Each folder directly inside My Pack is one anime. Season, part, cour, special and series sub-folders become seasons; disc, quality and subtitle folders are ignored. A folder without season folders shows its episodes directly.

Use names like \"Season 1\", \"S01\", \"第2季\" or \"Temporada 2\" to get \"Anime S01\". Parts and cours are kept, and labels such as \"Dear Sister\" become \"Anime Dear Sister\". Disc and release-group folders do not create seasons.

Numbers in S01E01, 1x01, EP01, E09, \"- 09\", [09], 第01话 and \"Episode 9\" are detected, including ranges and decimals. Years, resolutions, codecs, bit depths and audio channels are ignored. Files without a number are numbered in name order.
Anime folder names are matched against AniList for cover, studio, characters, recommendations and related entries. Add a TMDB API key for non-anime movies and TV.
Items in My Pack that were added from magnet links.
Files in My Pack that were not added from magnet links.
Anime folders inside these are listed at the top of the catalog. One folder ID or path per line. Example:\nMy Shared/Anime
Resolve the configured folders and report how many anime each one contains.
Use AniList for covers, studio, characters and suggestions. TMDB is used as fallback.
Used when AniList has no match, especially for movies and TV shows.
Probe each folder so a folder without sub-folders opens straight into episodes. Costs one request per folder when the catalog loads.
Only this resolution is offered for playback and downloads. When it is missing, the closest higher resolution is used, then lower ones.
